page.layout: One printed page. Running head and page number at the top. Marginal labels in the left margin: "2.Turcica," at the top, then "(1) Regni Turcici origo." and "(2.) divisio." beside the text. Main text in one column, with a chapter heading block above it and "Pe." at the lower right.

main_text.head: TURCICA.
Periodus I.
Can. I. Turci Persia potiti.
Explicatio:
main_text.p: (1) Regni Turcici origo.Turciæ gens pastoritia circa A.C. 1000. in Persiam migrarunt, ibiqve A.C. 1038 regem creârunt Togrul-beck, quem Historici Græci ac Latini corrupte vocant Tangrolipicem.
main_text.head: Canon 2.
main_text.p: (2.) divisio.Regnum Turcarum divisum in Orientale & Occidentale.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Occidentale complectebatur Asiam minorem, illudq; destruxit Godefridus Bullioneus A.C. 1098, cum terram Sanctam sive Hierosolymam recuperaret. Orientale sive Persi-cum destruxére Tartari.

page.notes: Left-margin label "2.Turcica," at the top beside the heading is a marginal note and is given here as a side label, not as running head. Faint show-through from the facing page appears at the right edge and is omitted. Printing forms: "Persia" and "Orientale" are printed as shown. Long s in "deftruxit" and "deftsuxére" is read as "destruxit" and "destruxére", with the printed hyphen kept in "Persi-cum". Words in the Orientale/Occidentale line are read clearly; no [?] marks were needed.
